title: 爱好与空闲时间
goal: 会聊自己喜欢做什么、多久做一次，能对别人的爱好表示兴趣并追问。
tips: 问爱好：What do you like to do in your free time? / What do you do for fun?
说频率：every day, once a week, twice a month, sometimes, rarely（很少）。
对别人的爱好表示兴趣：That sounds fun! / How did you get into that?（你怎么开始玩这个的？）

exchanges.hear: What do you like to do in your free time?
exchanges.reply: I like reading and going hiking.

exchanges.hear: How often do you work out?
What kind of music are you into?
exchanges.replyZh: 主要是流行，也听些爵士。

exchanges.reply: I play badminton with my friends on weekends.

exchanges.hear: I've just started learning the guitar.
exchanges.reply: That sounds fun! How's it going?
exchanges.replyZh: 听起来很好玩！学得怎么样？

exchanges.hear: Have you seen any good movies lately?
exchanges.hearZh: 最近看了什么好电影吗？
exchanges.reply: Yes, I watched a great comedy last week.
exchanges.replyZh: 看了，上周看了一部很棒的喜剧。

exchanges.reply: I love it, but I'm not very good at it.
exchanges.replyZh: 很喜欢，不过做得不太好。

exchanges.hear: How did you get into photography?
exchanges.hearZh: 你是怎么喜欢上摄影的？
exchanges.reply: My dad gave me a camera when I was a kid.
exchanges.replyZh: 我小时候爸爸送了我一台相机。

lines.en: So, what do you like to do in your free time?
lines.zh: 那么，你空闲时喜欢做什么？

lines.en: I'm really into hiking. I go almost every weekend.
lines.zh: 我特别喜欢徒步，几乎每个周末都去。

lines.en: Wow, every weekend? Where do you usually go?
lines.zh: 哇，每个周末？一般去哪儿？

lines.en: The mountains near the city. How about you?
I like playing the guitar, and I sometimes go swimming.
lines.zh: 我喜欢弹吉他，有时候去游泳。

lines.en: That's cool. How long have you played the guitar?
About ten years. I play in a small band.
lines.zh: 大约十年了，我在一个小乐队里弹。

lines.en: Really? I'd love to hear you play sometime.
lines.zh: 真的吗？哪天想听你弹一下。

lines.en: Sure! We have a show next Friday. You should come.
lines.zh: 好啊！我们下周五有演出，你一定要来。
